purpose: attempt to reproduce the literature sweep's 0.217993225 by running its recorded method (plain nested scipy adaptive quadrature on the d-interval-length reduction, no kink splitting, no endpoint treatment)

runs.note: abandoned after ~50 min without converging; the two completed settings already answer the question

conclusion: A naive scipy pipeline of the recorded shape lands 9.0e-10 from the exact value, NOT at 0.217993225. The sweep's error is therefore not explained by generic adaptive-quadrature trouble on this reduction, and its mechanism could not be reconstructed. Note however that scipy's own error estimate (2.0e-11) is ~50x optimistic even here.
